# airspyhf

**Host tools and library for the Airspy HF+ HF and VHF receiver**

- **Version recorded:** 1.6.8
- **Categories:** `sdr-hardware`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/airspy/airspyhf>

## What it does

The library and utilities for the Airspy HF+ Discovery and its predecessors — a different product line from the Airspy R2 and Mini, aimed at HF and low VHF.

## Why you would want it

The HF+ is one of the better inexpensive HF receivers, and it is a separate driver from the wideband Airspy line. Installing the wrong one is why a working HF+ appears dead.

## Before it will work

Airspy HF+ hardware and the 03eb:800c udev rule shipped by libairspyhf1, recorded in the airspy hardware entry.

## Install and launch

- **Installed by name only** — it is in no profile.
- **Install:** `hammunition install airspyhf --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `airspyhf`

## Known problems

Distinct from the `airspy` package, which does not see this hardware. It is a receiver only and covers HF and low VHF rather than the wideband range the R2 covers.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
